- prefix="`r prefix`" is used to reference the files generated by the pipeline.
- `COUNT` = `r COUNT` controls whether the read-counting step using `featureCounts` is performed and is set to `FALSE` by default.

# Read `bismark` outputs with `bsseq`



```{r minfi_read_idat, eval=COUNT, echo=TRUE, results="verbatim"}
library(minfi)

idat_dir = "datashare/AlphaSperm/raw"

# Read all IDAT pairs found in the directory (symlinks are followed)
# force = TRUE allows mixing arrays with slightly different probe sets
rgSet = minfi::read.metharray.exp(base = idat_dir, force = TRUE)
sampleNames(rgSet)

# Check the array type: EPIC v2 needs a recent minfi and the EPICv2 annotation package
rgSet@annotation

# --- QC: detection p-values ---
detP = minfi::detectionP(rgSet)

# # Samples: drop those with a high mean detection p-value
# bad_samples = colMeans(detP) > 0.03
# print(colMeans(detP)[bad_samples])
# rgSet = rgSet[, !bad_samples]
# detP  = detP[, !bad_samples]

# --- Normalization ---
# Noob: background + dye-bias correction (a good default, works sample by sample)
mSet = minfi::preprocessNoob(rgSet)

# Alternative, between-sample normalization (assumes global methylation is similar across samples)
# gset = minfi::preprocessFunnorm(rgSet)

# # --- Probe filtering ---
# # Keep only probes with detP < 0.01 in all samples
# detP = detP[rownames(mSet), colnames(mSet)]
# keep = rowSums(detP < 0.01) == ncol(mSet)
# mSet = mSet[keep, ]
# detP = detP[names(keep)[keep],]


# Map to the genome, then remove probes overlapping SNPs
gset = minfi::mapToGenome(mSet)
gset = minfi::dropLociWithSnps(gset, snps = c("SBE", "CpG"), maf = 0)

# Remove sex chromosomes (important if sexes are mixed)
# ann  = minfi::getAnnotation(gset)
# gset = gset[!ann$chr %in% c("chrX", "chrY"), ]

# --- Final matrices ---
gset = minfi::ratioConvert(gset, what = "both")
beta = minfi::getBeta(gset)   # for interpretation
mval = minfi::getM(gset)      # for statistics (limma, lfmm, PCA)
dim(beta)
sum(is.na(beta))

# get hg38 annot...
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicRanges)

# hg19 coordinates of the probes kept after all filtering (names = probe IDs)
gr19 = granges(gset)

# UCSC chain file, to download once and unzip (import.chain needs it uncompressed):
# wget https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg19/liftOver/hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz
# gunzip hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz
chain = rtracklayer::import.chain("hg19ToHg38.over.chain")

lifted = rtracklayer::liftOver(gr19, chain)   # GRangesList, one element per probe

# Keep only probes that map to exactly one hg38 position
ok = lengths(lifted) == 1
sum(!ok)                                      # number of probes lost or ambiguous

gr38 = unlist(lifted[ok])
genome(gr38) = "hg38"

# Sanity check: the chromosome should almost never change
mean(as.character(seqnames(gr38)) == as.character(seqnames(gr19[ok])))

# Restrict the matrices to the lifted probes, in the same order
beta38 = beta[names(gr38), ]
mval38 = mval[names(gr38), ]

# Final table of hg38 coordinates per probe
anno38 = data.frame(
  probe = names(gr38),
  chr   = as.character(seqnames(gr38)),
  start = start(gr38),
  end   = end(gr38),
  strand = as.character(strand(gr38))
)
head(anno38)

# saveRDS(beta38, "beta38.rds")  
# saveRDS(mval38, "mval38.rds")  
saveRDS(beta38, paste0("datashare/", gse, "/beta_matrix.rds"))
saveRDS(mval38, paste0("datashare/", gse, "/mval_matrix.rds"))
saveRDS(anno38, paste0("datashare/", gse, "/anno38_df.rds")  )
saveRDS(detP  , paste0("datashare/", gse, "/pval_matrix.rds"))



```


```{r minfi object load}
beta = readRDS(paste0("datashare/", gse, "/beta_matrix.rds"))  
mval = readRDS(paste0("datashare/", gse, "/mval_matrix.rds"))  
anno = readRDS(paste0("datashare/", gse, "/anno38_df.rds"  ))  
pval = readRDS(paste0("datashare/", gse, "/pval_matrix.rds")) 
```


## Fingerprint (CpG coverage)

```{r fingerprint, eval=TRUE}
# layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)
# plot(density(detP))
# detP[detP==0] = min(detP[detP>0])
# plot(density(-log10(detP)))
cov = -log10(pval)
data = as.matrix(t(cov))
# Compute cumulative signal fractions for each row
cs = t(apply(data, 1, function(x) cumsum(sort(x)) / sum(x)))

fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
for (foi in c("null", fois)) {
  layout(1, respect=TRUE)
  col = as.numeric(e[,foi])
  names(col)=rownames(e)
  matplot(t(cs), type="l", lty=1, col=adjustcolor(col, alpha.f=0.7),
    xlab="Ranked genomic features",
    ylab="Cumulative fraction of signal"
  )
  legend("topleft", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi)
}
```


# PCA on methylation beta vales 



```{r beta_matrix}
meth = list(
  mval = mval,
  beta = beta
)
```

```{r pca, results="verbatim"}
for (k in names(meth)) {
  print(k)
  data = as.matrix(t(meth[[k]]))
  dim(data)
  # data = data[,!apply(is.na(data), 2, any)]
  # dim(data)
  pca = prcomp(data, scale=FALSE)
  v = pca$sdev * pca$sdev
  p = v / sum(v) * 100

  nbpcs = 10
  pcs = pca$x[, 1:nbpcs]
  saveRDS(pcs, paste0("e_pcs_", k, ".rds"))
  # Variance of sample covariates explained by cumulative principal components

  fois = factoi[sapply(factoi, function(fa) {class(e[[fa]])})=="factor"]
  for (foi in c("null", fois)) {
    layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
    # layout(matrix(1:2,1), respect=TRUE)
    barplot(p, ylab="% of variance explained", xlab="components")
    cols = as.numeric(e[rownames(pca$x),foi])
    legend("topright", col=1:length(levels(e[,foi])), levels(e[,foi]), pch=16, title=foi, bty="n")

    for (i in 1:5) {
      j = i+1
      plot(
        pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j],
        xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
        ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
        col=cols,
        pch=16
      )
    }
    layout(1, respect=TRUE)
    i=1 ; j = i+1
    plot(
      pca$x[,1], pca$x[,j],
      xlab=paste0("PC", i, "(", signif(p[i], 3), "%)"),
      ylab=paste0("PC", j, "(", signif(p[j], 3), "%)"),
      col=adjustcolor(1, alpha.f=0.5),
      main=k,
      pch=16
    )
    text(pca$x[,i], pca$x[,j], rownames(pca$x))
  }
}
```



```{r}
meanbeta = apply(as.matrix(beta), 1, mean)

layout(matrix(1:2, 1), respect=TRUE)

# Plot global beta distribution
hist(as.vector(meanbeta),
     breaks = 100,
     col = "grey70",

     xlab = "Beta value",
     ylab = "Frequency",
     main = "DNA methylation distribution")




library(GenomicRanges)

# Convert the data.frame to a GRanges object, keeping probe IDs as metadata
gr = makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  anno,
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
  seqnames.field = "chr",
  start.field = "start",
  end.field = "end",
  strand.field = "strand"
)

# Sort by chromosome and position
gr = sort(gr)
# Compute distances between consecutive CpGs
pos_by_chr = split(start(gr), as.character(seqnames(gr)))
d = unlist(lapply(pos_by_chr, function(pos) {
    diff(pos)
}), use.names = FALSE)

# Plot the distribution
hist(log10(d),
     breaks = 100,
     col = "grey70",
     border = NA,
     xlab = "log10(Distance between consecutive CpGs)",
     main = "CpG spacing distribution")
```



# Latent Factors

```{r latent factor, results="verbatim", eval=TRUE}
# Binary covariate coded 0/1 
# e$smoking01 = as.numeric(e$smoking) - 1

for (k in names(meth)) {
  print(k)
  data = as.matrix(t(meth[[k]]))
  dim(data)

  ### LF with lfmm
  # Center each site: lfmm has no intercept and tot must be a centered variance
  Y = scale(data, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  X = as.matrix(e[rownames(Y), factoi[sapply(e[,factoi], is.numeric)]])
  stopifnot(!anyNA(X), !anyNA(Y))

  lfmm_fit = lfmm::lfmm_ridge(Y = Y, X = X, K = 10, lambda = 1e-5)
  U = lfmm_fit$U # latent factors
  V = lfmm_fit$V # loadings
  rownames(U) = rownames(Y)
  rownames(V) = colnames(Y)
  colnames(U) = paste0("LF", seq_len(ncol(U)))
  saveRDS(scale(U), paste0("e_lfs_", k, ".rds"))

  # Total variance of the centered Y
  tot = sum(Y^2)

  # Squared singular values of U V^T = eigenvalues of (U'U)(V'V)
  ev = sort(Re(eigen(crossprod(U) %*% crossprod(V))$values), decreasing = TRUE)

  pct_lf = 100 * ev / tot
  names(pct_lf) = paste0("LF", seq_along(pct_lf))
  print(round(pct_lf, 2))

  # Cumulative percentage
  print(round(cumsum(pct_lf), 2))

  barplot(pct_lf, ylab = "% of variance explained", xlab = "latent factors", main = k)
}
```



```{r results="verbatim"}
for (prfx in c("pcs", "lfs")) {
  print(prfx)
  for (k in names(meth)) {
    print(k) 
    layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)
    # First nbpc PCs (columns are named PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4, PC5, PC6)
    pcs = readRDS(paste0("e_", prfx, "_", k, ".rds"))


    res = do.call(rbind, lapply(factoi, function(f) {
      y = e[rownames(pcs), f]

      # Binary categorical variable -> 0/1 coding
      if (is.character(y) || is.factor(y)) {
        y = factor(y)
        if (nlevels(y) != 2) {
          message("Skipping ", f, ": ", nlevels(y), " levels (binary or numeric only)")
          return(NULL)
        }
        y = as.numeric(y) - 1
      }

      # Drop samples with missing values for this variable
      ok = !is.na(y)

      do.call(rbind, lapply(1:ncol(pcs), function(k) {
        d   = data.frame(y = y[ok], pcs[ok, 1:k, drop = FALSE])
        s   = summary(lm(y ~ ., data = d))
        fs  = s$fstatistic
        data.frame(
          variable = f,
          n        = sum(ok),
          PCs      = ifelse(k == 1, "PC1", paste0("PC1-PC", k)),
          r2       = round(s$r.squared, 3),
          adj_r2   = round(s$adj.r.squared, 3),
          p_value  = signif(pf(fs[1], fs[2], fs[3], lower.tail = FALSE), 3),
          row.names = NULL
        )
      }))
    }))

    # Cumulative number of PCs (1..nbpcs) for each variable, based on the row order of res
    res$k = ave(seq_len(nrow(res)), res$variable, FUN = seq_along)

    vars = unique(res$variable)
    xlim = range(res$k)

    # One panel per variable, extra right margin for the second y axis
    layout(matrix(1:6,2), respect=TRUE)

    for (v in vars) {
      d = res[res$variable == v, ]

      # Left axis: R2 (solid) and adjusted R2 (dashed)
      plot(
        d$k, d$r2, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "steelblue",
        xlim = xlim, ylim = range(c(0, d$r2, d$adj_r2)),
        xaxt = "n", xlab = "Number of PCs (PC1 to PCk)", ylab = "R2",
        main = paste0(v, " (n=", d$n[1], ")")
      )
      axis(1, at = d$k)
      lines(d$k, d$adj_r2, type = "b", pch = 1, lty = 2, col = "steelblue")
      abline(h = 0, col = "grey80")

      # Right axis: p-value on a log scale, overlaid on the same panel
      par(new = TRUE)
      plot(
        d$k, d$p_value, type = "b", pch = 17, col = "firebrick",
        log = "y", xlim = xlim, ylim = c(min(1e-3, d$p_value), 1),
        axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = ""
      )
      axis(4, col.axis = "firebrick", col = "firebrick")
      mtext("p-value (log scale)", side = 4, line = 3, col = "firebrick", cex = 0.8)

      # Significance threshold
      abline(h = 0.05, col = "firebrick", lty = 3)

      # Legend only once
      if (v == vars[1]) {
        legend(
          "topleft", bty = "n", cex = 0.7,
          legend = c("R2", "adjusted R2", "p-value", "p = 0.05"),
          col = c("steelblue", "steelblue", "firebrick", "firebrick"),
          pch = c(16, 1, 17, NA), lty = c(1, 2, 1, 3)
        )
      }
    }
  }
}


```
